name: Toraba!
source:
Due often business trips that his parents have in overseas, Shunsuke, who have no siblings, lives mostly alone. But, there always were two people who looked out after him. The kindly widow Ren and her daughter Ai who live next door.

Ren always took care of him when his parents were abroad and Ai, who has been friend with him since childhood, was like a sister to him.
However, as he’s gotten older, Shunsuke starts thinking differently about both girls, and they feel the same about him and thus love triangle between them blooms. Which a girl will Shunsuke eventually choose?

[Adapted from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=710791]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
父母经常出国出差，独生子今村骏介大多数时候都独自生活。不过，住在隔壁的温柔寡妇香住恋与女儿香住爱始终关照着他。

骏介父母不在时，恋总会照顾他；青梅竹马的爱则如同亲妹妹。可随着年龄增长，骏介看待两人的眼光渐渐发生变化，而她们也对他怀有同样的感情，一场三角恋由此展开。骏介最终会选择谁？

[根据 [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=710791]Getchu[/url]修改]
